==Notes==
*In [[hard mode]], [[Aura of Faith]] makes these Centaurs competent healers. They come in larger numbers in [[Deldrimor Bowl]] which can make it impossible for an unprepared party to kill a group with 3 or 4 such Centaurs. [[List of enchantment removal skills|Enchantment removal skills]] are highly recommended against them. Skills that apply [[condition]]s, including [[daze]]d, are discouraged due to the fact that Shiverpeak Protectors can easily remove for a heal boost (due to [[Divine Favor]]).
